The Government of Vietnam Proposes a Pilot Visa for Remote Workers

Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Lam Thi Phuong Thanh presented a draft resolution on special mechanisms and policies for tourism development to the National Assembly. The draft proposes a controlled pilot program for foreigners working remotely in Vietnam. It also includes more flexible visa and residency conditions for medical tourists and individuals coming for long-term treatment, rehabilitation, or relaxation, along with accompanying family members.

The proposal aims to attract higher-spending tourists and strengthen the competitiveness of the tourism industry. The draft includes the expansion of bilateral visa-free regimes for key markets and a more flexible visa policy prioritizing high-income, long-stay, and repeat visitors, as well as conference participants. The government also proposes simplifying the issuance of work permits, visas, and temporary residence for foreign experts and artists involved in tourism projects.

The pilot program for remote workers has not yet been adopted. The Culture and Social Affairs Committee of the National Assembly, while assessing the project, noted that the resolution should not establish specific visa rules for separate groups and called for further clarification on the novelty, features, and boundaries of the proposed special visa policy. Specific rules, fees, and application procedures for the pilot visa have not been established. Remote workers will continue to use the standard electronic visa valid for up to 90 days.

📌 Address Poisoning: Why Your Transaction History Can Trick You

Main Points
⏺ Scammers send tiny or zero-value transfers from addresses that look like ones you use
⏺ Copying an address from your wallet history can send funds straight to the attacker
⏺ This post explains how address poisoning works and how to avoid it


1️⃣ Core Idea — an attacker creates an address that matches the first and last characters of one you often use, then makes it appear in your transaction history.
2️⃣ Why It Works — most wallets shorten addresses to something like 0x12ab…89cd, so a fake with the same start and end looks identical at a glance.
3️⃣ Example — you regularly send USDT to 0x12ab…89cd. A scammer sends you a 0 USDT transfer from a lookalike 0x12ab…89cd. Next time you copy the latest address from history, your funds go to the attacker.
4️⃣ Risk Surface — blockchain transfers can't be reversed, so one wrong paste can mean a permanent loss.
5️⃣ Practical Rule — save trusted addresses in your address book, check the full address, not just the edges, and send a small test transaction before large transfers.
Final Thoughts

Address poisoning doesn't hack your wallet — it hacks your habits. A few extra seconds of checking can save the whole transfer.

Europe’s winter energy strategy now depends on mild weather. Gas storage stood at 72% on October 1, well below the EU’s 90% target, and the Iran war has added more than €127 billion to the region’s energy import bill.

A stress test of a cold winter with tight global LNG supplies shows European reserves ending the season barely 10% full, even after a painful 15% cut in demand. Germany’s stocks could run out by March. Europe has little room left for another disruption.

Governments have committed almost €35 billion to cushion the shock. Much of that support is poorly targeted and encourages fossil-fuel consumption, Bloomberg reports. It softens prices without fixing the shortage behind them.

Replacing Russian supplies with American imports has also handed Washington leverage. Earlier this year, Trump threatened a diesel export ban that put half of Europe’s diesel imports at risk. Sweden’s energy minister called trading one dependence for another “problematic.”

German porcelain maker Kahla plans to close after 182 years, with gas accounting for up to 70% of its operating costs. Its 100 workers will be out of jobs long before Europe’s long-term energy strategy pays off.

In the statistics, the closure will register as lower industrial demand for gas. The balance improves because the factory is gone.
